cyclist.still_prompt: Photo from a phone worn on a pedestrian's chest at 1.2 m height, looking straight ahead, slight wide-angle lens, realistic, natural colors, San Francisco, overcast morning. The walker stands at the curb of a zebra crosswalk. A cyclist is about to ride across the crosswalk from the left, about 4 meters ahead.
cyclist.motion_prompt: The cyclist rides across the crosswalk from left to right in front of the camera. The camera moves slowly forward toward the curb.
cyclist.kite_should: beeps from the left that speed up; 'Stop.' if the bike crosses the walking corridor

car_turning.still_prompt: Photo from a phone worn on a pedestrian's chest at 1.2 m height, looking straight ahead, slight wide-angle lens, realistic, natural colors, San Francisco, overcast morning. The walker is on the curb at a crosswalk. A silver sedan on the right is starting a right turn into the crosswalk, about 6 meters away.
car_turning.motion_prompt: The car turns right through the crosswalk, crossing in front of the camera. The camera stays still at the curb.
car_turning.kite_should: a car warning from the right before it enters the walker's path

doorway.still_prompt: Photo from a phone worn on a pedestrian's chest at 1.2 m height, looking straight ahead, slight wide-angle lens, realistic, natural colors, San Francisco, overcast morning. A narrow sidewalk beside shop fronts. A man is stepping out of a shop doorway on the right, about 3 meters ahead, into the walker's path.
doorway.motion_prompt: The man walks out of the doorway and steps into the middle of the sidewalk, toward the camera. The camera walks slowly forward.
doorway.kite_should: person beeps from the right, then 'Stop.' when he is close and in the corridor

oncoming.still_prompt: Photo from a phone worn on a pedestrian's chest at 1.2 m height, looking straight ahead, slight wide-angle lens, realistic, natural colors, San Francisco, overcast morning. A busy sidewalk. A woman looking at her phone is walking straight toward the camera, about 7 meters ahead.
oncoming.motion_prompt: The woman keeps walking straight at the camera while looking at her phone. The camera walks forward toward her.
oncoming.kite_should: beeps from ahead that speed up as she closes in, then 'Stop.'

scooter.still_prompt: Photo from a phone worn on a pedestrian's chest at 1.2 m height, looking straight ahead, slight wide-angle lens, realistic, natural colors, San Francisco, overcast morning. A sidewalk with an electric rental scooter lying across it, about 3 meters ahead, partly blocking the path.
scooter.motion_prompt: The camera walks slowly forward along the sidewalk toward the scooter lying on the ground.
scooter.kite_should: a low obstacle ahead; the chest camera's job, the drone can't see it
